key_insight: Platform pitching can increase or decrease mean floating-wind-turbine power depending on the operating region, while a power-curve-aware actuator disk model prevents unphysical power overshoot.
engineering_relevance: Floating wind farm power predictions should account for motion-driven operating-region changes and inter-turbine motion correlations.
method: LES of fully developed aligned turbine arrays with periodic horizontal boundaries and moving surface drag.
Compare power-curve-aware and constant-coefficient actuator disk models.
Prescribe harmonic pitching of IEA 15MW turbines and vary row-to-row motion phase.
evidence_signal: Across simulated wind-wave conditions, the power-curve-aware model eliminates unrealistic power excursions, and in-phase pitching produces larger farm-scale fluctuations through stronger turbine correlations.
watch_item: Prescribed harmonic motion and periodic, fully developed arrays may not capture coupled platform dynamics or finite-farm effects.
paper_title: A Large Eddy Simulation Study of Turbine Pitch Motion Effects on Power Generation in Fully Developed Floating Wind Turbine Arrays
